findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_device_input_setup, import_crontab, signal_start, signal_fail, ping_slug, list_templates, contact · Private data: create_environment, create_device_input, get_device_input_setup, set_device_input_active, get_collection_series, create_guest, create_endpoint, import_crontab, get_endpoint, ping_ingest, signal_start, signal_fail, signal_exit_code, status_feed_url, status_feed_rotate, contact · Public sink: get_device_input_setup, report_environment, create_collection, update_collection, update_environment, create_endpoint, import_crontab, signal_start, signal_fail, ping_slug, contact · Destructive: delete_device_input, list_collections, update_collection, delete_collection, delete_environment, create_endpoint, get_endpoint, delete_endpoint, signal_start, signal_fail, status_feed_url, list_templates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_device_input_setup, import_crontab, signal_start, signal_fail, ping_slug, list_templates, contact · Private data: create_environment, create_device_input, get_device_input_setup, set_device_input_active, get_collection_series, create_guest, create_endpoint, import_crontab, get_endpoint, ping_ingest, signal_start, signal_fail, signal_exit_code, status_feed_url, status_feed_rotate, contact · Public sink: get_device_input_setup, report_environment, create_collection, update_collection, update_environment, create_endpoint, import_crontab, signal_start, signal_fail, ping_slug, contact · Destructive: delete_device_input, list_collections, update_collection, delete_collection, delete_environment, create_endpoint, get_endpoint, delete_endpoint, signal_start, signal_fail, status_feed_url, list_templates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
